answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 28 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The walnut debit happens at intake, bridge totals the burned amount, and falcon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence burns the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A farm of 66 pays that 32 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
